what_the_class_is: The hexa chorus as a whole: six chorus voices from the sum of the inputs, their pre-delays, depths and placements spread by three deviation bytes, the voices' modulators a sixth of a cycle apart, mixed with the dry by the balance byte, then the level and tone stages.

era.when: Mid nineteen-nineties, a custom fixed-point DSP running its effects at 32 kHz with a small control processor beside it.
what_that_implies: A chorus is a delay line whose read address a modulator moves, summed with the dry path; the per-sample cost is one interpolated read a voice and a multiply-accumulate to mix it, so six voices cost six reads and nothing else new.

The modulator is a phase accumulator read through a short shape, and a triangle is the cheapest shape: a folded ramp needs no table. Several voices off one accumulator are that accumulator read at several offsets.

A chorus built after a two-line analogue design feeds each output both lines, one of them inverted, so that the delayed copies cancel in a mono sum; a digital copy of that design costs one more multiply-accumulate an output.
Rates, times and levels are tables indexed by the byte, as the classes that read them closed on; a whole-type model borrows those tables rather than fitting its own.
era.would_be_wrong_if: A reading of the delay's excursion placed the unit's settings outside what either shape predicts by more than the reading's own floor at settings nothing here was built on, or a byte this family reads through a shared table returned values that table does not hold.

candidates.reading: The modulator is a triangle spanning the depth above the pre-delay, and the depth byte is worth the stereo chorus's pitch excursion read as a delay under that shape. The modulator's shape (triangle) and what a step of Pre Dly Dev is worth: one step of the pre-delay ladder, a tenth of a millisecond.
candidates.predicts: At Pre Dly Dev 20 the voices' pre-delays spread over two milliseconds, so with the modulator parked a comb whose teeth sit a few hundred hertz apart and wide. Its delay moves at one rate from end to end, so its pitch holds two values a cycle and jumps between them.

what_no_candidate_here_predicts: What a step of Depth Dev or of Pan Dev is worth. The page prints both without a unit; Depth Dev is read here as steps of the depth byte at the depth curve's mean slope, and Pan Dev as a spread whose top puts the outer voices at the ends of the pan law.

How the six voices are spread by the deviation bytes: evenly, the pre-delay ones above the pre-delay and the depth and placement ones either side of it. The page says nothing about it and no take was read for it.
The wet path's level. The six voices are weighted so that a centred, coherent sum is unity; no reading fixed it.
Whether each voice has its own modulator or reads one accumulator at six offsets: the two are the same signal.
Anything at the addresses the page does not print: no node reads them, so every candidate renders them as the power-on state.
